skills.skill: Define a physical change (no new substance; only shape, size or state changes) and give examples
Define a chemical change (a new substance with new properties forms) and recognise its signs: gas, colour change, heat or light, new smell, new solid
Classify everyday changes using evidence, knowing that 'can it be reversed?' is a clue but not the rule
Tell melting apart from dissolving and know that dissolved substances are still present

misconceptions.belief: Melting ice is a chemical change because it looks different.

turns.text: umm, aluminium sheet ko bas dabaya toh... woh sirf shape change hui na? kyunki dhakkan ab bhi aluminium ka hi hai... toh physical hoga? haan, physical badlav hai, kyunki naya substance nahi bana, bas shape badli. waise, aluminium sheet ka photo dikhao na, kaise dikhti hai?

Bilkul, sheet ki shape badli, aluminium wahi raha, isliye physical badlav. Aluminium sheet ki photo ban rahi hai; yeh patli, chamakdaar metal ki chadar jaisi hoti hai. Tab tak sochiye: mombatti ka wax pighalna aur baati jalna, dono mein kaunsa physical aur kaunsa chemical badlav hai, aur kya saboot hai?

wax pighalna toh physical hua na, because woh dobara jam sakta hai? aur baati jalna... usmein toh aag lagi aur light aaya, toh woh chemical? par saboot kya hai... pata nahi, baati jalne se kuch naya banta hai kya? ek example dikhao na, jaise baati jalne ke baad kya bacha?

Wax pighalna physical hai aur baati jalna chemical. Wax thanda hokar phir jam sakta hai, lekin pakka saboot yeh hai ki woh wax hi rehta hai; baati jalne par raakh aur gas jaise naye substances bante hain. Ek aur case sochiye: baarish ke baad iron railing par laal-bhoori parat ban jaaye, toh yeh kaunsa badlav hai, aur kyun?

ghee pighalna... aapne abhi toh bataya na, woh physical hai! kyunki woh dobara jam sakta hai, solid ban sakta hai, aur woh ghee hi rehta hai, naya kuch nahi banta. haan, physical badlav hai. waise, ghee ka photo dikhao na jab woh pighla hua hota hai?

Aapne ghee ke solid se liquid banne aur ghee hi rehne ki baat ki. Pighle ghee ki tasveer ban rahi hai; woh peele liquid jaisa dikhta hai. Ab doodh bahar rehkar khatta ho aur phat jaaye, toh physical badlav hoga ya chemical, aur kya saboot hai?

umm, doodh phatne par woh curd banata hai na, meri mummy dahi banati hain... toh woh chemical hoga? par, wait, dahi ko wapas doodh bhi banaya ja sakta hai kya, fridge mein rakh ke? mujhe lagta hai haan, toh shayad physical bhi ho sakta hai... pata nahi, main confuse hoon. ek example dikhao na, jaise phatte doodh ka photo?

Aapka confusion samajh aaya: doodh phatna aur dahi jamna alag processes hain, lekin fridge mein rakhne se dono wapas doodh nahi bante. Phate doodh ki photo ban rahi hai; usmein safed dane aur alag paani jaisa hissa dikhta hai. Ab poster kaatne aur sparkler jalne mein, agar dono pehle jaise nahi ban sakte, toh chemical badlav kaunsa hai aur sirf wapas na ban paana kaafi saboot kyun nahi hai?

poster ko kaatna matlab bas shape chhoti hui, woh toh physical hua na... sparkler mein aag lagi aur light aaya, toh naya substance bana — chemical hoga. aur saboot... pata nahi, reversibility poori nahi bata sakti, but sparkler mein smell bhi aati hai aur aag se roshni, yeh evidence hai. aise hi bolun?

Haan, aise boliye: poster mein sirf shape badli; sparkler jalne par roshni aur nayi smell milti hai. Sirf wapas na ban paana kaafi saboot nahi, kyunki kata poster bhi pehle jaisa nahi banta. Ab tyohaar par mithai banate waqt ek physical aur ek chemical badlav kya ho sakta hai?

umm... tyohaar pe kitchen mein, mithai banate waqt... oh, meri mummy barfi banati hain na, toh pehle ghee garam karti hain, woh pighalta hai na, toh woh physical badlav hai, bas solid se liquid, ghee hi hai. aur phir doodh garam karein aur usmein cheeni daalein, toh woh mix hokar ek naya taste aata hai, gaadha ho jata hai, mithai banti hai... toh woh chemical hoga? par wait, cheeni aur doodh bas m

Doodh mein cheeni milne se naya taste aata hai, par sirf taste badalna chemical badlav ka pakka saboot nahi; bread toast hone par alag rang aur smell aati hai. Kunal kehta hai ki namak paani mein pighal jaata hai; use kaunsa shabd bolna chahiye, aur yeh pighalne se kaise alag hai?

accha... namak paani mein pighalta nahi, woh dissolve hota hai na? kyunki pighalne mein garam karna padta hai, jaise ghee, aur dissolve mein nahi. toh use 'dissolve' bolna chahiye. aur alag isliye hai kyunki dissolve mein namak gayab ho jata hai par paani mein rehta hai, pighalne mein solid liquid ban jata hai garam karne se. waise, namak dissolve ka photo dikhao na, microscope se?

Namak paani mein dissolve hota hai, pighalta nahi. Aapne sahi kaha ki pighalne mein solid liquid banta hai; dissolve hone par namak gayab nahi hota, bas paani mein fail jaata hai. Microscope-jaisi tasveer ban rahi hai; usmein namak ke chhote particles paani mein faile hue honge. Agar paani ke glass mein do chammach cheeni poori ghol dein, toh glass ka wazan badhega, utna hi rahega ya ghatega?

ummm... wazan toh badhega na? kyunki cheeni daali hai, toh glass mein cheeni bhi hai ab... lekin wait, woh dissolve ho gayi toh dikhti nahi, toh shayad wazan utna hi rahe? pata nahi, main hamesha yeh confuse hoti hoon... ek baar maine apni beaker mein cheeni daali thi science lab mein, miss ne kaha tha kuch but main bhool gayi. wazan badhega ya nahi, yeh batao na? aur haan, wazan scale ka photo di
Haan, cheeni dikhna band hoti hai, par glass mein rehti hai. Taraazu ka photo ban raha hai; tab tak sochiye, cheeni daalne se pehle aur baad mein glass ke andar cheeni ki matra mein kya farq hai?
umm... cheeni dikhna band hoti hai par woh hai toh andar hi na, glass mein? toh matra badh gayi na, do chammach daali na... toh wazan bhi badhega, kyunki cheeni ka wazan bhi add hoga. haan, badhega!

Haan, wazan badhega: cheeni dikh nahi rahi, lekin glass mein uska wazan ab bhi hai. Ab do drinks compare kariye: ek mein room-temperature paani mein sugar ghulti hai, doosre mein chocolate garam karke liquid banti hai. Kis mein dissolving hai, aur kis mein melting?

umm... room-temperature paani mein sugar daali toh woh dissolving hua na, kyunki woh gayab ho gayi bina garam kiye? aur chocolate ko garam kiya toh woh melting hui, solid se liquid bani. lekin sugar ab bhi hai kya? haan, shayad hai, paani mein kahin... par dikhti nahi toh pata kaise chala?
Bilkul: paani mein sugar dissolve hui, aur garam chocolate melt hui. Sugar paani mein rehti hai; paani udaane par sugar phir mil sakti hai. Ab chemical badlav ke do sanket kaunse ho sakte hain?

umm... chemical badlav ke sanket... ek toh gas banna, jaise soda mein bubbles, aur doosra colour change, jaise rusting mein brown ho jana? aur wait, heat ya light bhi hota hai na, sparkler ki tarah? toh main do kya bolun? gas aur colour bol doon?

Aapne gas, colour aur heat ya light ke examples diye; do ke liye gas aur colour bol sakte hain. Ab ek naya case: do saaf liquids milane par mixture dhundhla hota hai aur safed solid dikhta hai. Chemical badlav ka sabse mazboot saboot kya hoga?

umm, solid naya bana na? pehle toh dono saaf the, ab safed solid dikh raha hai... toh woh new substance hai, iska matlab chemical change hua. sabse mazboot saboot naye solid ka banna hai. par yeh solid dikhao na, waise kaisa hota hai?

Aapne pehle saaf liquids aur baad mein safed solid ka farq pakda. Us solid ki tasveer ban rahi hai; woh paani mein chhote safed kanon jaisa dikh sakta hai, isliye mixture dhundhla lagta hai. Ab baking soda mein nimbu ka ras daalein, toh kya dikhega aur kya sunaayi dega, aur yeh physical badlav hoga ya chemical?
